documentation_exclusion: Markdown/rst excluded from source/test manifest. Compiled usage documents are separately hashed. All Cargo/source/test fixtures+manifests/bench/script/CI non-Markdown inputs are included, including untracked files.

scope_limits: This matrix runs ordinary tests. Explicitly ignored official-C oracle and external-corpus tests have separate evidence; unsupported ignored cases remain unsupported.

The matrix source/test/script/CI fingerprint was frozen before a planned CI-only correction from encode::tests::reverse_fields_preserve_zero_and_full_width_values to bitwriter::tests::reverse_fields_preserve_zero_and_full_width_values and the addition of current-family Miri selectors. These later CI edits and their separately recorded focused checks are outside this matrix; no corrected CI selector is claimed to have executed here.
Documentation-only files are excluded from the source/test fingerprint. Both compiled usage documents have separately verified identical before/after hashes.
Per-command output hashes use normalized lines rejoined with LF; log_sha256 hashes the complete raw log file.
command_exit_code_evidence: The shell uses set -eu; a later traced command establishes successful completion of its predecessor. Both the complete shell process and the supplementary rustdoc process returned zero.
